chunks: "Any man who is directed by a woman is cursed."

key_terms.امْرِئٍ: a man; an individual male person
key_terms.تُدَبِّرُهُ: manages or directs him; administers his affairs
key_terms.كُلُّ: every; indicates generality in the statement

ai.seo_question: What did Imam 'Alī عليه السلام say about a man who is ruled by a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Imam 'Alī عليه السلام a condemnatory statement about a man whose affairs are managed by a woman. It is presented as a brief ethical warning concerning personal authority, dependence, and social order.
